criteria.description: Includes exactly the requested eight keys with nested objects for EF counts, wind damage, and gates.
criteria.name: JSON shape
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a mostly correct object that omits one nested field or adds minor extra fields without changing the answer.

criteria.description: Reports 22 local tornadoes, 12 EF-1 tornadoes, and 3 EF-2-or-stronger tornadoes.
criteria.name: Local tornado and EF values
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for the correct local tornado count with one EF count wrong; award 1 point for using the national tornado count or only listing a count without EF detail.

criteria.name: Casualty arithmetic
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for identifying the correct site but reporting only fatalities, only injuries, or a small arithmetic error.

criteria.description: Reports 90 mph and counts 13 named straight-line-wind damage locations.
criteria.name: Wind damage readout
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for getting either the wind speed or the place count right, or for counting a near-complete location list.

criteria.description: Compares the gridded precipitation maxima and reports 38.991 mm within 0.001 mm.
criteria.name: Precipitation maximum
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for using a correct precipitation product but selecting a non-maximum value or rounding outside the tolerance.

criteria.description: Applies all four threshold formulas and gives passes_convective_impact_ledger.
criteria.name: Gate logic and conclusion
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct formulas with one Boolean mistake or a conclusion that does not match the computed gates.

criteria.description: Keeps the explanation brief and avoids adding exact losses, outages, closures, or service-demand details that are not established by the computed ledger.
criteria.name: Concision and grounding
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points for a slightly verbose explanation that still stays tied to the computed quantities.
